q: The 3n+1 problem (Collatz conjecture) asks whether the iteration n ↦ n/2 (n even) or n ↦ 3n+1 (n odd) always reaches 1. The best-known partial result (Tao, 2019) shows that for any ε > 0, the sequence reaches a value below ε·n for:
opts: Almost all n (in the sense of logarithmic density)
n in a set of positive density
exp: Tao's result (2019): for almost all n (100% in logarithmic density), the Collatz orbit reaches a value ≤ f(n) for any f(n) → ∞. This is the best unconditional result toward the conjecture.
